title: HSK 1.10 · 旁边, 外国, 没关系, 干净, 一点儿
focus: 喝 · 穿 · 花 · 干 · 块 · 外 · 半 · 关 · 左 · 右 · 国 · 没什么 · 旁边 · 那边 · 干净 · 这儿 · 哪儿 · 干什么 · 这边 · 右边 · 那儿 · 没关系 · 哪些 · 国外 · 外国 · 左边 · 楼上 · 一点儿 · 关上 · 玩儿 · 半天 · 后天 · 里边 · 外语 · 没事儿 · 一块儿 · 外边 · 汉语 · 后边
body:
Where things are and everyday set phrases. 边 (side) turns direction words into places, 儿 makes the Beijing-style -r ending, and 外 outside, 干, 关 and 没 come back in several words.

## Characters that repeat

| Character | Pinyin | Meaning | In this lesson |
|---|---|---|---|
| 边 | biān / bian | side (辶 + 力) | 旁边, 那边, 这边, 右边, 左边, 里边, 外边, 后边 |
| 儿 | -r | (erhua suffix) | 这儿, 哪儿, 那儿, 一点儿, 玩儿, 没事儿, 一块儿 |
| 外 | wài | outside; foreign | 国外, 外国, 外语, 外边 |
| 没 | méi | not have | 没什么, 没关系, 没事儿 |
| 国 | guó | country | 国外, 外国 |
| 干 | gān / gàn | dry / to do | 干净, 干什么 |
| 关 | guān | close; concern | 关上, 没关系 |
| 半 | bàn | half | 半天 |

## Watch out

- 干 is gān (dry) in 干净 but gàn (to do) in 干什么.
- 那 nà (that) vs 哪 nǎ (which): the question word has 口 on the left.
- 国外 = abroad, 外国 = foreign country: same characters, flipped.
- 左 has 工 underneath and starts with 一; 右 has 口 and starts with ノ.
- 边 is usually toneless after a direction (右边 yòubian), but full biān in 旁边.
- 干 vs 千 qiān (thousand): 千 starts with a slanted stroke.

cards.Example: 你想喝什么？ nǐ xiǎng hē shénme: What do you want to drink?
cards.Notes: 口 mouth + 曷 for the sound. Lookalike: 渴 kě (thirsty) has 氵 water instead of 口

cards.Meaning: to wear; to put on; to pass through
cards.Example: 穿上衣服。 chuānshang yīfu: Put your clothes on.
cards.Notes: 穴 hole + 牙 tooth: teeth boring through a hole, so 'pass through'. You put your limbs through clothes

cards.Example: 这是妈妈买的花。 zhè shì māma mǎi de huā: These are flowers Mom bought.
cards.Notes: 艹 plant + 化 huà for the sound

cards.Example: 你在干什么？ nǐ zài gàn shénme: What are you doing?
cards.Notes: gān = dry (干净); gàn = to do (干活). Lookalikes: 千 qiān (slanted top), 于 yú (hook at the bottom)

cards.Example: 这个五块钱。 zhège wǔ kuài qián: This is five yuan.
cards.Notes: 土 earth + 夬 for the sound (as in 快 kuài): a clod of earth, a lump

cards.Example: 外边很冷。 wàibian hěn lěng: It's cold outside.
cards.Notes: 夕 evening + 卜; learn it as those two pieces side by side. Opposite: 里 inside

cards.Example: 现在三点半。 xiànzài sān diǎn bàn: It's half past three.
cards.Notes: Traditionally explained as 八 split + 牛 ox: splitting an ox in two

cards.Example: 请关灯。 qǐng guān dēng: Please turn off the light.
cards.Notes: Simplified from 關 (a bolted 门 door). Opposite: 开 kāi open

cards.Example: 往左走。 wǎng zuǒ zǒu: Go left.
cards.Notes: A hand (𠂇) + 工 tool. Written 一 first, then ノ. Compare 右: hand + 口

cards.Example: 在右边。 zài yòubian: It's on the right.
cards.Notes: A hand (𠂇) + 口 mouth: the hand that feeds the mouth. Written ノ first, then 一. Compare 左

cards.Example: 你是哪国人？ nǐ shì nǎ guó rén: What country are you from?
cards.Notes: 囗 border + 玉 jade: a treasure inside borders (traditional 國 had 或 inside)

cards.Example: 没什么，别担心。 méi shénme, bié dānxīn: It's nothing, don't worry.
cards.Notes: 没 not have + 什么 what = there's no 'what' to it: nothing

cards.Example: 他坐在我旁边。 tā zuò zài wǒ pángbiān: He sits next to me.
cards.Notes: 旁 side + 边 edge = by the side

cards.Example: 你看那边！ nǐ kàn nàbian: Look over there!
cards.Notes: 那 that + 边 side = that side. Mirror: 这边

cards.Example: 房间很干净。 fángjiān hěn gānjìng: The room is clean.
cards.Notes: 干 dry + 净 clean (冫 + 争 zhēng for the sound) = dry and clean

cards.Example: 你来这儿。 nǐ lái zhèr: Come here.
cards.Notes: 这 this + 儿 (adds -r) = this spot. Same as 这里

cards.Example: 你去哪儿？ nǐ qù nǎr: Where are you going?
cards.Notes: 哪 which (口 + 那) + 儿 -r = which spot: where

cards.Meaning: to do what?; why on earth
cards.Example: 你干什么去？ nǐ gàn shénme qù: What are you off to do?
cards.Notes: 干 gàn do + 什么 what = do what. 干 is gàn here, not gān

cards.Example: 请这边走。 qǐng zhèbiān zǒu: This way, please.
cards.Notes: 这 this + 边 side = this side

cards.Example: 洗手间在右边。 xǐshǒujiān zài yòubian: The restroom is on the right.
cards.Notes: 右 right + 边 side

cards.Example: 我在那儿等你。 wǒ zài nàr děng nǐ: I'll wait for you there.
cards.Notes: 那 that + 儿 -r = that spot. 那 nà has no 口; 哪 nǎ does

cards.Example: 没关系，我不累。 méi guānxi, wǒ bú lèi: No problem, I'm not tired.
cards.Notes: 没 not have + 关系 connection = it has no bearing: it's fine. 关 means 'concern' here, not 'close'

cards.Example: 你要哪些？ nǐ yào nǎxiē: Which ones do you want?
cards.Notes: 哪 which + 些 some (plural) = which ones

cards.Example: 他在国外工作。 tā zài guówài gōngzuò: He works abroad.
cards.Notes: 国 country + 外 outside = outside the country. Flipped, 外国 = foreign country

cards.Example: 他是外国人。 tā shì wàiguórén: He's a foreigner.
cards.Notes: 外 outside + 国 country = an outside country. Flipped, 国外 = abroad

cards.Example: 我坐左边。 wǒ zuò zuǒbian: I'll sit on the left.
cards.Notes: 左 left + 边 side

cards.Example: 他住在楼上。 tā zhù zài lóushàng: He lives upstairs.
cards.Notes: 楼 floor, building (木 + 娄 lóu for the sound) + 上 up. Opposite: 楼下

cards.Example: 我会说一点儿。 wǒ huì shuō yìdiǎnr: I can speak a little.
cards.Notes: 一 one + 点 dot + 儿 -r = one dot: a little. 一 is read yì before a 3rd tone

cards.Example: 请把门关上。 qǐng bǎ mén guānshang: Please shut the door.
cards.Notes: 关 close + 上 (result: shut tight) = close up

cards.Example: 周末去哪儿玩儿？ zhōumò qù nǎr wánr: Where shall we go this weekend?
cards.Notes: 玩 = 王 (jade 玉) + 元 yuán for the sound: toying with jade; + 儿 -r

cards.Example: 我等了半天。 wǒ děngle bàntiān: I waited forever.
cards.Notes: 半 half + 天 day = half a day; in speech it means 'a long time'

cards.Example: 他后天来。 tā hòutiān lái: He's coming the day after tomorrow.
cards.Notes: 后 = after, behind; its opposite is 前 (qián), as in 前天, the day before yesterday

cards.Example: 里边有人吗？ lǐbian yǒu rén ma: Is anyone inside?
cards.Notes: 里 inside (田 field + 土 earth) + 边 side. Lookalike: 理 lǐ adds 王

cards.Example: 你会说外语吗？ nǐ huì shuō wàiyǔ ma: Do you speak a foreign language?
cards.Notes: 外 foreign + 语 language (讠 speech + 吾 wú for the sound) = foreign speech

cards.Example: 没事儿，你去吧。 méishìr, nǐ qù ba: It's fine, go ahead.
cards.Notes: 没 not have + 事 matter + 儿 -r = there's no matter: it's okay, or I'm free

cards.Example: 我们一块儿去吧。 wǒmen yíkuàir qù ba: Let's go together.
cards.Notes: 一 one + 块 lump + 儿 = in one lump: together (= 一起). 一 is yí before a 4th tone

cards.Example: 孩子在外边玩儿。 háizi zài wàibian wánr: The kids are playing outside.
cards.Notes: 外 outside + 边 side. Opposite: 里边

cards.Example: 我在学汉语。 wǒ zài xué Hànyǔ: I'm learning Chinese.
cards.Notes: 汉 the Han people (氵: named after the Han River) + 语 language = language of the Han

cards.Example: 你后边有人。 nǐ hòubian yǒu rén: There's someone behind you.
cards.Notes: 后 behind + 边 side = the back side. Opposite: 前边
